sourceCountDiscrepancy.resolution: Use the actual 103-row shopNumber=3 count from the committed itemtbl export; do not fabricate two records. Program 15 MVP catalog includes only the nine source-backed red/blue potion items.

sourcePolicyConflict.handling: Retain the source conflict. Program 15 MVP filter is explicitly scoped to the nine red/blue potion item IDs; no conflict resolution is claimed.

potionRecovery.policy: Do not consume a potion or change HP/MP while the numeric restoration amount is UNKNOWN. The runtime supports applying an amount when a verified amount is supplied later.
